extensionDescription.message: Displays Markdown files in Firefox as clean, readable pages with light and dark themes.

permissionDescription.message: Firefox needs your one-time approval to access files on your computer. The extension only displays Markdown files that you open in the browser.

permissionPrivacy.message: Your files never leave your computer.

permissionGranted.message: Ready! You can now open .md and .markdown files with Firefox.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted. You can try the button again.

permissionError.message: There was a problem requesting permission. You can enable local file access in Firefox's extension settings.
